The '''G-X1 Onslaught''', also known as '''G-X1 Firehauler''', was a [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] model produced by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The design has impressed many pilots within both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the latter of whom made a bulk purchase of G-X1 to add to their starfighter complements.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==History==
[[File:G-X1_Onslaught.png|thumb|left|200px|An unarmed G-X1 bomber]]
G-X1 Onslaught fighters were used by the Republic during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]]. Several of these ships were destroyed, while still landed, by Imperial operatives during the Imperial attack on the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]].<ref name="TOR:RI">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Repelling Invasion|Balmorra}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The G-X1 first appeared as an unnamed ship in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR:RI" /> It was later introduced in the Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' as the G-X1, referred to as "Firehauler" for Republic players and "Onslaught" for Imperial players. It was a Premium ship, available only through the Cartel Market. Gameplay wise, it was functionally identical to the [[Warcarrier]]/[[B-4D Legion]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
